history.summary: THIS IS A JAIN TEMPLE (DIGAMBARA), NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. Moraji Digambar Jain Temple stands inside the Ganesh Digambar Jain Sanskrit Vidyalaya campus at Laxmipura, Sagar (470002; phone +91 75822 34168). Visitor reviews say Varni Bhavan Moraji was built in 1905 and is established as the oldest Jain institution of Sagar, with a Sanskrit college, Jain hostel, dharamshala and the Tapobhumi (place of penance) of Ganesh Prasad Varni, whom guru sanghas visit regularly. A business listing describes idols of Lord Mahavira and Lord Bahubali, a circular auditorium where Jain monks address devotees, and ~50 dharamshala rooms (verify). Opening hours conflict across listings (5:30 AM-12:30 PM vs 'open 24 hours') - verify locally.

name: Moraji Digambar Jain Temple
town: Sagar (Laxmipura, Ganesh Digambar Jain Sanskrit Vidyalaya campus)
town_description: Sagar is a major city in central Madhya Pradesh, headquarters of Sagar district, known for Lakha Banjara Lake, the Dr. Hari Singh Gour University, and Eran's Gupta-era temples nearby. It lies on NH-26 between Bhopal and Jabalpur. The Moraji Digambar Jain Temple sits at Laxmipura in the city, within the campus of one of Sagar's oldest Jain educational institutions.
